producer_report.summary: OLY-B-GOAL-03 now records the existing pre-dispatch forecast path as its mechanism (reading.rs, run/mod.rs, invariant.rs, status.rs) and has the measure ending `status: forecasts`. I added ("forecasts","forecasts") to STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS. I moved the status forecasts rows into a forecast_headline_lines helper whose first-row label is the literal "forecasts   "; the output text is unchanged. I added three tests (spec entry, reading forecast and refusal without one, printed rows) and a CHANGELOG entry. Scoring and refusal rules are unchanged.
